verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers LathamDrive digital tools, including a legal document generator, the Automated Convertible Note template generator, and an interactive glossary app. A buyer could reasonably ask whether such a platform provides AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes AI analysis of user data or AI-generated suggestions; template-based document generation and glossary search are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
